title: providerPickerDefaults
responsibility: The model and reasoning effort the model picker selects for a provider from the catalog.

inputs.name: pickerDefault.provider
inputs.description: The provider id whose default is wanted, compared with strict equality. Only 'harness-claude' gets the Opus 5.5 preference and the xhigh rule; any other string, such as 'openai', gets the first catalog model with its defaultEffort.

inputs.name: pickerDefault.choices
inputs.description: The catalog models of that provider, in the order given (the function neither sorts nor filters them). For 'harness-claude' the first entry whose model id and label, joined by a space, match /opus[\s-]*5[.-]5/i (case-insensitive) is picked, else choices[0]; an empty array yields model '' and effort ''.

outputs.name: pickerDefault
outputs.description: The model id and effort to select: for 'harness-claude' the Opus 5.5 entry when one matches (else choices[0]), with effort 'xhigh' when that entry lists 'xhigh' in efforts and its defaultEffort otherwise; any other provider gets choices[0] with its defaultEffort. Both fields are '' when choices is empty.
